# Copilot instructions (ClawAI Coding Agent)

Read `AGENTS.md` (router) and `CLAUDE.md` (engineering policy, never-list) first.

Akinator runs on every change with no command (`docs/RULES.md` rules 17 and 18): follow
`skills/akinator/SKILL.md`; homes are in `context/akinator-station-map.md`. Docs, the wiki
(`docs/wiki/`), skills, rules, `context/` and `memory/` change in the same commit as the code,
with the business, product and technical why and the tests actually run.
